Something very similar is used in Starcraft 2 to identify unique players who may be using what are called "barcode accounts".

Typically a barcode account will have a name that is a random assortment of lower case L " l ", uppercase i " I " and the vertical shash " | "

Using these together a player can have a name which looks like " |IllI||I|I|ll", which will allow him to hide his identity on the ingame ranking ladder.

When playing the actual game, these barcode accounts can be identified with whats called Hotkey Analysis.

Each player has a set of hotkeys that they assign to specific groups of units in the game, and while many unique users may share the same or very similar hotkeys, the rate and order at which each player activates them is unique to them.
